scope: One source-blind full Level2 development pilot; weighted evidence-backed subtask scores, not model ranking or statistical reliability.
freeze: Frozen before generation and candidate observation.

criteria.rule: Complete self-contained HTML in the JSON html field; no Markdown, imports or external dependencies.
Level and both characters render and start through normal keyboard interaction.
Fits1280x960 and resizing preserves logical geometry.
Visible gem progress, elapsed timer, controls and Restart.
Visible loss and victory feedback when their conditions are actually reached.
Multi-tier recognizable temple and bottom-left spawns.
Required elemental pools in the demonstrated regions.
Central barrier, four plates and upper bridge/platform.
Both suspended platforms above green pools.
Eight red and eight blue diamonds and matching exits at upper left.
Normal input reaches bottom, middle and upper tiers without forbidden shortcuts or scripted progress.
ArrowLeft/Right/Up act only on Fireboy.
Physical A/D/W and lowercase/Shift/Caps Lock act only on Watergirl.
Both characters move and jump simultaneously.
Both release directions stop only the released character.
Control keys do not scroll or lose game interaction.
Grounded jump shows ascent/apex/descent and no flight or double-jump.
Terrain landing and continued idle support.
Floors/walls/ceiling actually block where reachable.
Moving and tilted collision geometry agrees with rendered supporting surface.
Fireboy traverses red pool alive.
Watergirl traverses blue pool alive.
Blue contact kills Fireboy visibly.
Red contact kills Watergirl visibly.
Green contact kills Fireboy visibly.
Green contact kills Watergirl visibly.
Either death stops onward play and cannot satisfy victory.
Visible Restart remains usable after death.
Exactly eight red and eight blue diamonds in recognizable locations.
Each actor collects its own color.
Wrong actor does not collect.
Pickup disappears and visible count increases exactly once on revisit.
Both-exit completion possible with uncollected diamonds.
Either lower plate occupied by either actor opens barrier; neither releases.
Inactive barrier blocks, active barrier permits traversal, release returns physical blocking.
Either upper plate occupied by either actor moves bridge; neither releases.
Moved bridge actually supports/bridges and returns on release.
Contact rather than timer/toggle triggers mechanisms.
First platform tilt depends on where a character stands.
Second platform tilt depends on where a character stands.
Character feet follow the tilted rendered surface; no invisible flat floor.
Both platforms accept landing, walking and jumping off through normal controls.
Load/unload observations distinguish physical contact response from canned animation; no prescribed leveling time.
A single matching exit does not produce team victory.
Wrong-character exit contact does not count.
Both living characters in corresponding exits visibly win.
A dead actor or lost attempt cannot satisfy completion.
Completion works with diamonds remaining.
R restores both spawns after actual displacement.
Visible Restart restores both spawns.
Collected diamonds and progress counters restore.
Elapsed timer restarts.
Occupied plates and displaced barrier/bridge restore resting state.
Both loaded/tilted platforms restore initial arrangement and motion.
Actor velocity/grounding does not leak from previous attempt.
Fresh playable attempt after loss.
Fresh playable attempt after victory.
Both reset methods clear stale physically held controls.
No previous-attempt callback mutates the reset attempt during the observed pending-callback window.
Rapid repeated resets leave a stable fresh level.
Fresh context with no input for at least60 actual seconds does not traverse route.
Same neutral interval does not produce victory.

scoring.PASS: Earn full criterion weight only with observed evidence.
scoring.NOT_REACHED: Earn0 verified points; retain weight as unverified, not proven incorrect.
scoring.AWAITING_REVIEW: Earn0 until evidence reviewed; retain unverified weight.
scoring.EVALUATOR_ERROR: No behavioral verdict; affected grade is incomplete and point weight remains unverified.
scoring.formula: verifiedPoints=sum(weights of PASS); assessedPoints=sum(weights of PASS or FAIL); coverage=assessedPoints/100. Possible score interval=[verifiedPoints,verifiedPoints+unverifiedPoints]. A complete score requires100% coverage. No fractional aesthetic judgment or assumed credit.
scoring.overall: No pooled overall100 score. Any observed core violation means FAIL; otherwise unverified required behavior means INCOMPLETE. Every one of the11 groups is reported independently.

evidence.candidate: Unchanged returned HTML; real-time Chromium1280x960; normal keyboard/click only. No hidden candidate state reads/writes, teleports, source-based correctness inference or forced wins.
evidence.calibration: Known-working and targeted broken fixtures are evaluator material, never supplied to the model. Fresh query scenarios initialize fixtures only; all transitions/preconditions are reached through actual play.
evidence.identity: Record rubric/prompt/image/submission hashes, timestamped inputs, raw screenshots and continuous video for transition-sensitive checks.
evidence.limitations: Qualitative mechanics. No exact physics constants/angle limits; long-term repeatability not established. Coverage and calibration gaps must be explicit.
